outputs.with:
Subject: A gentler start to your week

We want our space to work for neighbors whose schedules fall outside a standard weekday rhythm. From October 6 onward, our Sunday opening moves to 10 am with shift workers in mind. Please drop in whenever it suits your morning, whether you need coffee or quiet time.
